column1: 22880§incorporate§ɪnˈkɔːpəreɪt§vt. 把…合并，纳入；包含，吸收§This will depend on when carmakers incorporate the necessary monitoring and control systems into their vehicles.§这将取决于汽车制造商何时将必要的监测控制系统安装到汽车上。

22881§trace§treɪs§vt. 追踪，追查；追溯；描摹，标出 n. 痕迹；微量§The origin of modern architecture can be traced back to the social and technological changes of the 18th and 19th centuries.§现代建筑的起源可追溯到18、19世纪出现的社会和科技变革。
22882§convey§kənˈveɪ§vt. 传送，运送；表达，传递送§His poem conveyed a sense of sorrow.§他的诗表达了一种悲伤的情感。
22883§boundary§ˈbaʊndri§n. 分界线；边界§Mount St. Helens is located along the boundary of two of the moving plates that make up the Earth's crust.§圣海伦斯火山位于组成地壳的两大移动板块的边界线上。
22884§frank§fræŋk§adj. 坦白的，直率的§Will you be frank with me about this matter?§在这件事上你能不能坦白地跟我说？

22885§bonus§ˈbəʊnəs§n. 奖金，红利；好处§Scrapping farm-price support and protection for coal-mining offers a two-fold bonus: a cleaner environment and a more efficient economy.§取消农产品价格补贴和煤矿开采保护有双重好处：第一，营造了更干净的环境；第二，发展了更高效的经济。
22886§militant§ˈmɪlɪtənt§adj. 好战的，好斗的；激进的 n. 好斗的人，激进分子§One militant group warned the government to take notice.§一个激进的团体警告政府要注意。
22887§starve§stɑːv§v. （使）挨饿；（使）饿死§Thousands of people starved during the war.§战争中，成千上万的人饿死。
22888§refresh§rɪˈfreʃ§v. （使）复原；刷新，更新；使精神振作，使精力恢复§My job is to make sure that you all feel relaxed and refreshed.§我的工作就是保证你们都感觉放松且精力充沛。
22889§dystrophy§ˈdɪstrəfi§n. 营养障碍；营养不良§In 1986, American researchers identified the genetic defect underlying one type of muscular dystrophy.§1986年，美国研究人员确认了导致一种肌肉萎缩症的遗传缺陷。
22890§conduce§kənˈdjuːs§v. 有益于，有助于；导致§Money, fame and wealth do not always conduce to happiness.§金钱与名利并不一定就能给人们带来幸福。
22891§consulate§ˈkɒnsjələt§n. 领事馆；领事职位，领事任期§Peter's father used to be a consul working in the American consulate in China.§彼得的父亲曾经是一名领事，在美国驻中国领事馆工作。
22892§contaminant§kənˈtæmɪnənt§n. 致污物，污染物§Before shipment we have to make sure that all equipment is clean and free of contaminants.§装船之前我们需要确定所有的设备都是整洁的、未受到污染的。
22893§demerit§diːˈmerɪt§n. 过失；缺点，短处§I was asked to discuss my best friend's merits and demerits objectively.§我需要客观地讨论我最好朋友的优缺点。
22894§denomination§dɪˌnɒmɪˈneɪʃn§n. 命名；（货币的）面额，面值；宗教派别§Christians of all denominations attended the conference.§各教派的基督徒都参加了会议。
22895§disturbance§dɪˈstɜːbəns§n. 扰乱，打扰；骚乱，混乱；心神不安，烦恼；障碍§The construction work is creating constant noise, dust and disturbance.§建筑工程带来持续不断的噪音、灰尘以及混乱。
22896§enjoyable§ɪnˈdʒɔɪəbl§adj. 令人愉快的，使人快乐的§There is going to be a very enjoyable TV programme this evening.§今天晚上将有一期非常有意思的电视节目。
22897§expiry§ɪkˈspaɪəri§n. 满期，终结§The expiry date of my credit card is November 12th 2028.§我的信用卡有效期限是到2028年11月12日。
22898§fluctuation§ˌflʌktʃuˈeɪʃn§n. 波动，起伏；动摇§The decision was affected by his fluctuation of mood.§这个决定受到他情绪波动的影响。
22899§frequency§ˈfriːkwənsi§n. 频繁；频率§There is an increasing frequency of attacks in this primitive tribe.§这个原始部落受到越来越频繁的袭击。
22900§hence§hens§adv. 因此，所以；今后，从此§People all believe firmly that the true consequences will be known several days hence.§人们都坚信几天后真实的结果将公之于众。
22901§inadequate§ɪnˈædɪkwət§adj. 不充分的；不适当的§Mary rejected the $3 million compensation as totally inadequate.§玛丽拒绝了300万美元的赔偿金，她认为那是完全不够的。
22902§keystone§ˈkiːstəʊn§n. （计划、论据等的）基础，主旨；拱顶石§Changes to the social welfare system are the keystone of the government's reforms.§社会福利系统的改革是政府改革的基础。
22903§manifest§ˈmænɪfest§adj. 明显的 vt. 表明，显示 n. 货物清单；乘密名单§The symptoms of the disease manifested themselves ten days later.§这种疾病的症状在十天后表现了出来。
22904§marginally§ˈmɑːdʒɪnəli§adv. 稍微，些微§Mother thought the products were marginally more expensive, so she would not afford it this time.§妈妈认为这些商品稍有点贵，因此她这次买不起。
22905§moderately§ˈmɒdərətli§adv. 适度地，不过分地，有节制地§Linda did moderately well in the sports competition and she won the third place in the game.§琳达在这次运动会上适度发挥，最后取得第三名的成绩。
22906§noticeable§ˈnəʊtɪsəbl§adj. 显而易见的；明显的§There has been a noticeable improvement in Tim's learning.§蒂姆的学业有了明显的提高。
22907§optic§ˈɒptɪk§adj. 眼睛的；视觉的 n. （光学仪器的）镜头，光学部件§The wound hurt his optic nerve that he could no longer see things.§伤口触及他的视觉神经，他再也看不到东西了。
22908§outweigh§ˌaʊtˈweɪ§vt. 比…重；（在重要性、影响上）比…更重要；胜过，强于§The risks are vastly outweighed by the potential benefits.§潜在的利益要远远高于所要承担的风险。
22909§adverse§ˈædvɜːs§adj. 不利的，有害的§Smoking can produce substantial adverse effects on the heart and lungs.§吸烟会对人的心脏和肺造成严重的危害。
22910§finale§fɪˈnɑːli§n. （音乐的）终曲；终场§No other performer has managed to equal their grand finale.§他们的压轴大戏令其他表演者望尘莫及。
22911§astonish§əˈstɒnɪʃ§vt. 使惊讶，使吃惊§The news astonished everyone.§这个消息使所有人大吃一惊。
22912§charge§tʃɑːdʒ§n. 价钱，费用；管理，照管，掌管；控告，指控；电荷，电量v. 索取（金额），要价；控告，指控；委以；指示；（使）充电§Drivers will be charged according to the roads they use.§根据司机行驶的道路对其收费。
22913§corps§kɔːz§n. 特种部队；兵团§The Marine Corps experience launched my machinist career. It also made me realize that learning how-to-learn is a powerful tool.§海军陆战队的经历开启了我的机械师生涯。它也让我意识到学习如何学习是一个强大的工具。
22914§module§ˈmɒdjuːl§n. 模块；模式；（航空器中的）舱；组件；单元§The school offers you 10-week modules of English courses.§该学校为你提供为期10周的英语课程单元。
22915§petroleum§pəˈtrəʊliəm§n. 石油，原油§This newly discovered substance can burn like petroleum.§这种新发现的物质可以像石油一样燃烧。
22916§stylish§ˈstaɪlɪʃ§adj. 时髦的；漂亮的§Their uniforms are stylish.§他们的制服很时髦。
22917§dump§dʌmp§vt. 倾卸，倾倒 n. 垃圾场§Dredgers suck up clay and mud and dump them in deeper waters.§挖泥船挖出黏土和泥，然后将其倒入更深的水域。

22918§debris§ˈdebriː§n. 碎屑，残骸；【地质】岩屑§As the sliding ice and snow melted, it touched off devastating torrents of mud and debris, which destroyed all life in their path.§下滑中的冰雪融化后会引发泥石流，破坏力极大，催毁途经的一切生物。
22919§irony§ˈaɪrəni§n. 反话，讽刺；出人意料的事情§It reveals the power of the pauses and noises we use to play for time, convey emotion, doubt and irony.§这表现出停顿和噪音的力量，我们用它们来拖延时间，表达情感、质疑和讽刺。
22920§component§kəmˈpəʊnənt§n. 成分；零部件 adj. 构成的，组成的§It is often easier to check individual components before assembly takes place in many manufacturing processes.§在许多生产工序中，在组装之前先检查单个零部件通常更容易。
22921§fieldwork§ˈfiːldwɜːk§n. 实地调查，野外考察§Elinor's fieldwork, followed up by her experimental work, pointed us in exactly the right direction.§埃丽诺的实地考察，还有随后进行的实验性工作，给我们指出了正确方向。
22922§contaminate§kənˈtæmɪneɪt§vt. 污染§Chemical fertilisers and pesticides may contaminate water supplies.§化肥和杀虫剂可能会污染水源。
22923§applicant§ˈæplɪkənt§n. 申请人§We have interviewed twenty-six applicants and none of them are qualified.§我们已经面试了26个申请者，没一人符合条件。
22924§strap§stræp§n. 带子 vt. 捆扎；（用绷带）包扎§This strap on my briefcase is broken.§我公文包的这根带子断了。

22925§fundamental§ˌfʌndəˈmentl§adj. 基础的，基本的 n. [pl.] 基本原理§The fundamental conditions and resources for health are peace, education, food, a viable income, and a stable ecosystem.§和平、教育、食物、足以维持生计的收入和稳定的生态系统是健康的基本条件和源泉。

22926§conclusion§kənˈkluːʒn§n. 结论，推论；结束，结尾；【法】缔结，议定§At the clinic we have come to the conclusion that the major cause of back pain is not with the design of chairs, but in the way we sit in them.§临床试验得出的结论是，背痛不是由椅子的设计引起的，而是我们的坐姿造成的。
22927§intensity§ɪnˈtensəti§n. 强烈，剧烈；强度§The pulse laser is increasing its intensity.§脉冲激光的强度在不断增加。
22928§notable§ˈnəʊtəbl§adj. 值得注意的；显著的，杰出的，显赫的 n. 名人；重要人物§The most notable of these activities was the Woman's Exhibition.§在这些活动中，最引人注目的是妇女作品展。
22929§implement§ˈɪmplɪment§vt. 使生效，实施；贯彻，执行[ˈɪmplɪmənt] n. 工具§Policy makers struggle to define and implement appropriate legislation.§政策制定者们致力于阐释和执行适当的法规。
22930§cervical§ˈsɜːvɪkl§adj. 子宫颈的；颈部的§Smoking is thought to cause about 14 percent of leukemia and cervical cancers.§约14％的白血病和宫颈癌被认为是由吸烟引发的。
22931§plot§plɔt§n. 情节；阴谋；小块土地§The plot of this film was too complicated for me.§这部电影的情节对我来讲太复杂了。
22932§acquaint§əˈkweɪnt§vt. 使认识；使熟悉§Films provide an ideal opportunity to acquaint viewers with something unknown.§电影给观众提供了一个了解未知事物的绝佳机会。
22933§violence§ˈvaɪələns§n. 暴力行为；激烈，猛烈§Capital punishment is essential to controlling violence in society.§死刑对控制社会上的暴力事件具有重要意义。
22934§revolve§rɪˈvɒlv§v. （使）旋转§Fifteen satellites all revolve about the planet's equator.§15颗卫星都绕着这颗行星的赤道旋转。
22935§vegetarian§ˌvedʒəˈteəriən§n. 素食者 adj. 素食者的；素食的§The restaurant offers special meals for vegetarians.§这家饭店为素食者准备了特别的食物。
22936§ratio§ˈreɪʃiəʊ§n. 比，比率§The male to female ratio of volunteers is 4 to 5.§志愿者中男女比例为4比5。
22937§scream§skriːm§v. 尖叫 n. 尖叫声§The students screamed in excitement.§学生们激动得尖叫起来。
22938§steep§stiːp§adj. 陡峭的；（价格等）过高的；急剧的§It's very steep here and the surface is a little slippery.§这儿很陡，地面还有点滑。
22939§interior§ɪnˈtɪəriə(r)§adj. 内部的，里面的 n. 内部；内地§The secret of the versatility of glass lies in its interior structure.§这种多功能玻璃的奥秘就在于它的内部结构。
22940§analogous§əˈnæləgəs§adj. 类似的§The task was strictly analogous to the one that we had finished before.§这个任务和我们先前完成的那个极为相似。
22941§high-tech§ˌhaɪ ˈtek§adj. 高科技的 n. 高科技§The architectural style usually referred to as high-tech was emerging.§经常被称为高科技的建筑风格涌现了出来。

22942§aggressive§əˈɡresɪv§adj. 侵犯的，侵略的，挑衅的；有进取心的，有冲劲的§The incentive for the more aggressive use of rockets came not from within the European continent but from far-away India.§将火箭用作更具攻击性武器的动机并非来自欧洲大陆，而是来自遥远的印度。
22943§process§ˈprəʊses§n. 过程；步骤，程序；工艺流程 vt. 加工；处理；办理§Reforming the educational system will be a difficult process.§教育制度的改革将是一个艰难的过程。
22944§hum§hʌm§n. 嗡嗡声，嘈杂声 vi. 哼（曲子）；发出嗡嗡声§The hum of conversation died away as the curtain rose.§幕布升起时，嗡嗡的谈话声渐渐消失。
22945§sinister§ˈsɪnɪstə(r)§adj. 不吉祥的，凶兆的；险恶的，邪恶的§In your remarks you alluded to certain sinister developments.§你的话语中暗示了一些不祥的势头。
22946§refinement§rɪˈfaɪnmənt§n. （精细的）改善，改进；精制的改良品；精炼；文雅§The progress in refinement of machine tools has been substantial in recent years.§近年来，机床的改进取得了相当大的进展。
